title: Sordland/Turn06/PSnW_HealthBudget
description: Choice to Privatise Healthcare. Several choices on healthcare spending if budget is available. Building hospitals, increasing salaries and upgrading existing hospitals.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was having my afternoon tea in th..."
entries.dialogueText: I was having my afternoon tea in the state house office in Deyr and going through newspapers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One of the headlines piqued my inte..."
entries.dialogueText: One of the headlines piqued my interest. It read 'Polio Crisis in Wehlen'.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before I could start reading, I hea..."
entries.dialogueText: Before I could start reading, I heard a couple of knocks. Paskal entered followed by Lucian.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Mr. President. It's time for the s..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. It's time for the scheduled healthcare meeting.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Good afternoon.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good afternoon.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Very well. Let's begin.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well. Let's begin.”
entries.menuText: “Very well. Let's begin.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Please take your seats.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Please take your seats.”
entries.menuText: “Please take your seats.”

entries.title: Player_Italic: "I nodded and they have taken their..."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded and they have taken their seats and Paskal produced documents from his suitcase. He put them on the table.
entries.menuText: Nod.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They have taken their seats and Pas..."
entries.dialogueText: They have taken their seats and Paskal produced documents from his suitcase. He put them on the table.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Paskal looked at the newspaper I wa..."
entries.dialogueText: Paskal looked at the newspaper I was reading.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Very troubling news from Wehlen, M..."
entries.dialogueText: “Very troubling news from Wehlen, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“I have just returned from a meetin..."
entries.dialogueText: “I have just returned from a meeting with our top scientists on the matter of Polio. It seems to be spreading.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Indeed. This might have dire conse..."
entries.dialogueText: “Indeed. This might have dire consequences in the region.”
entries.menuText: “Indeed. This might have dire consequences in the region.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm not worried. It will stop befo..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm not worried. It will stop before it reaches Sordland.”
entries.menuText: “I'm not worried. It will stop before it reaches Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“What I was told by our researchers..."
entries.dialogueText: “What I was told by our researchers was that with the current infection rate there will soon be millions of people affected by Polio.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“We need to be ready for any possib..."
entries.dialogueText: “We need to be ready for any possibility.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I doubt it is that serious yet.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I doubt it is that serious yet.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Regardless, back to the topic. Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: “Regardless, back to the topic. Mr. Beniwoll.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Mr. Beniwoll?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Beniwoll?”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Yes. Yes, of course. Let's start.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes. Yes, of course. Let's start.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Paskal put on his reading glasses a..."
entries.dialogueText: Paskal put on his reading glasses and went through the documents. He didn't say anything for a whole minute.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He put the papers down, cleared his..."
entries.dialogueText: He put the papers down, cleared his throat and looked at me.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“As you know, I have been preparing..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you know, I have been preparing a new privatization program that would create funds through selling of unused ministry property and some extra taxes.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“The overall mood has been positive..."
entries.dialogueText: “The overall mood has been positive as the administration focuses more on the healthcare. I'm excited about what we can achieve with the allocated funds.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“The reduction of health funds is g..."
entries.dialogueText: “The reduction of health funds is going to hurt no matter how we manage it. I will need to make big concessions, which will hamper our efforts.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“But I'm still happy that the admin..."
entries.dialogueText: “But I'm still happy that the administration continues to support healthcare at the same level as before. Though, this limits our options significantly.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We will have to make do with what..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will have to make do with what we have. I want you to lead the way to solutions in healthcare.”
entries.menuText: “We will have to make do with what we have. I want you to lead the way to solutions in healthcare.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“I don't think that this is a matte..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't think that this is a matter that can be easily solved. More thought needs to be put in how do we go about lowering our budget or where do we cut it from.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“I'm personally invested to solve t..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm personally invested to solve the horrible infant and maternal death rates along with your requests.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm sure you can figure out a way..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm sure you can figure out a way to come out of this strong. I have put trust in you.”
entries.menuText: “I'm sure you can figure out a way to come out of this strong. I have put trust in you.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“I don't see many ways out of this..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't see many ways out of this particular situation. We need funds to bring improvements.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Our health services seem to be wor..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our health services seem to be working fine and don't require more investment. I'm sure we can improve what we have.”
entries.menuText: “Our health services seem to be working fine and don't require more investment. I'm sure we can improve what we have.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Healthcare isn't a urgency for thi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Healthcare isn't a urgency for this administration. We have to make do with less.”
entries.menuText: “Healthcare isn't a urgency for this administration. We have to make do with less.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We have to minimize service dispar..."
entries.dialogueText: “We have to minimize service disparity in the country. The situation isn't good at all.”
entries.menuText: “We have to minimize service disparity in the country. The situation isn't good at all.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Providing better healthcare is our..."
entries.dialogueText: “Providing better healthcare is our goal. This administration will be known to have supported the welfare services.”
entries.menuText: “Providing better healthcare is our goal. This administration will be known to have supported the welfare services.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“In general, I am very content with..."
entries.dialogueText: “In general, I am very content with the budget decision that was made.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“In general, the ministry is somewh..."
entries.dialogueText: “In general, the ministry is somewhat content with the budget decision that was made. At least we didn't get a cut.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“In general, the ministry is not ve..."
entries.dialogueText: “In general, the ministry is not very content with the decision to cut the budget of our healthcare system.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“This comes as no surprise as I kno..."
entries.dialogueText: “This comes as no surprise as I know you are a man of your word. ”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“This comes as a very pleasant surp..."
entries.dialogueText: “This comes as a very pleasant surprise that we all welcomed at the ministry.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Do you have any specific areas of..."
entries.dialogueText: “Do you have any specific areas of focus in mind?”
entries.menuText: “Do you have any specific areas of focus in mind?”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Although, I have to say this came..."
entries.dialogueText: “Although, I have to say this came as a surprise to many since one of our campaign focuses was healthcare. I am not sure if we're abiding by that promise.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Although, I have to say this came..."
entries.dialogueText: “Although, I have to say this came as a surprise to many since one of our campaign focuses was healthcare. I am not sure if we're abiding by that promise.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What kind of concessions?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What kind of concessions?”
entries.menuText: “What kind of concessions?”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“I am still formulating a plan.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I am still formulating a plan.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I know of this too, Paskal. But th..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know of this too, Paskal. But this goes against our economic doctrine. Additionally, health is a key sector people expect to have in public hands.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“It might not go against our strate..."
entries.dialogueText: “It might not go against our strategy to promote a market economy, but I'm personally against privatization of government services. Such vital services must be under state control.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Aside from creating additional fun..."
entries.dialogueText: “Aside from creating additional funds, there is a long-term problem with privatization in a country like Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Messing with that structure will d..."
entries.dialogueText: “Messing with that structure will definitely hurt us politically in the future. That I know for sure.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“The market should take care of it..."
entries.dialogueText: “The market should take care of it by itself. We can't regulate people like that.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“I do agree that there is some conc..."
entries.dialogueText: “I do agree that there is some concern there... But the benefits of competitive and quality services is greater.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You are right. There might be stru..."
entries.dialogueText: “You are right. There might be structural issues... Especially due to private greed and market manipulation.”
entries.menuText: “You are right. There might be structural issues... Especially due to private greed and market manipulation.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don't see a problem with privati..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't see a problem with privatization. It would create additional funds and boost enterprise.”
entries.menuText: “I don't see a problem with privatization. It would create additional funds and boost enterprise.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“We will prevent the worst case sce..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will prevent the worst case scenarios. There needs to be healthy structural improvements in this sector.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Also in a country where most peopl..."
entries.dialogueText: “Also in a country where most people don't have access to quality healthcare...”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“People are already lacking proper..."
entries.dialogueText: “People are already lacking proper healthcare even though it is free. What happens when you privatise? Prices increase as state hospitals close due to sales.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“For now it wouldn't. Privatization..."
entries.dialogueText: “For now it wouldn't. Privatization would be fair if our healthcare standards were high and accessible for all.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What are those problems?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What are those problems?”
entries.menuText: “What are those problems?”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“This is not Arcasia nor Lespia. Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is not Arcasia nor Lespia. You are talking about Sordland, in which the healthcare is free for now.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“We have people who have their live..."
entries.dialogueText: “We have people who have their lives depending on a service that is free to them.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“But the choice is yours, Mr. Presi..."
entries.dialogueText: “But the choice is yours, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We'll keep healthcare in state con..."
entries.dialogueText: “We'll keep healthcare in state control. Don't allow any private involvement that could endanger core health services.”
entries.menuText: “We'll keep healthcare in state control. Don't allow any private involvement that could endanger core health services.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It's largely due to outdated facil..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's largely due to outdated facilities that lack proper hygiene standards and equipment."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Building new hospitals sounds inte..."
entries.dialogueText: “Building new hospitals sounds interesting. It would also boost our popularity.”
entries.menuText: “Building new hospitals sounds interesting. It would also boost our popularity.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Excellent. We can turn that extra..."
entries.dialogueText: “Excellent. We can turn that extra money to something useful. I shall let my partners know.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“As you wish. The health services s..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you wish. The health services shall remain in public hands.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I don't think this was the right c..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't think this was the right choice.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Good choice.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good choice.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Very well. Fruitful meeting nevert..."
entries.dialogueText: “Very well. Fruitful meeting nevertheless. Nice and short.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Improve rural treatment by hiring..."
entries.dialogueText: “Improve rural treatment by hiring health staff and upgrading equipment in rural areas.”
entries.menuText: “Improve rural treatment by hiring health staff and upgrading equipment in rural areas.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Increase salaries of doctors, nurs..."
entries.dialogueText: “Increase salaries of doctors, nurses and other health staff with incentives for rural areas.”
entries.menuText: “Increase salaries of doctors, nurses and other health staff with incentives for rural areas.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Build new hospitals where they are..."
entries.dialogueText: “Build new hospitals where they are needed. Access to health will be available for all.”
entries.menuText: “Build new hospitals where they are needed. Access to health will be available for all.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Since we will have extra funds, th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Since we will have extra funds, the spending policy question remains.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Now let's get to the big question..."
entries.dialogueText: “Now let's get to the big question of how we will spend the extra funds dedicated to the Ministry of Health.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Paskal gathered his documents and l..."
entries.dialogueText: Paskal gathered his documents and left along with Lucian.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Just the way I like it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Just the way I like it.”
entries.menuText: “Just the way I like it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you for the meeting.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for the meeting.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you for the meeting.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It's a visible, tangible improveme..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a visible, tangible improvement that we can present as our achievement."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""The sad reality is that our rural..."
entries.dialogueText: "The sad reality is that our rural clinics are woefully outdated, ill-equipped, and understaffed."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“We can initiate one more spending..."
entries.dialogueText: “We can initiate one more spending policy with our funds. Which one would should we initiate?”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“I urge you to consider these propo..."
entries.dialogueText: “I urge you to consider these proposals. We could build new hospitals where necessary, divert funds to increase the salaries of our health workers, or invest in enhancing the existing treatment facilities in rural areas.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""While the construction of new hosp..."
entries.dialogueText: "While the construction of new hospitals is an appealing idea, I personally don't see it as a primary concern."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Each of these options presents a u..."
entries.dialogueText: “Each of these options presents a unique path towards improving healthcare access and quality in Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""However, implementing a nationwide..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, implementing a nationwide, proportional salary boost would pay off politically."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Therefore, I believe improving tre..."
entries.dialogueText: “Therefore, I believe improving treatment in rural areas should be our course of action, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few minutes went by in contemplat..."
entries.dialogueText: A few minutes went by in contemplation as the moment to make a decision came near.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Increasing salaries should have a..."
entries.dialogueText: “Increasing salaries should have a good effect for doctors, nurses and other staff who work so hard for our citizens.”
entries.menuText: “Increasing salaries should have a good effect for doctors, nurses and other staff who work so hard for our citizens.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Improving treatment in rural areas..."
entries.dialogueText: “Improving treatment in rural areas is a must. It would prevent mistreatment, disease and sickness.”
entries.menuText: “Improving treatment in rural areas is a must. It would prevent mistreatment, disease and sickness.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""Well, that wraps up our discussion..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, that wraps up our discussion for now."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“It would be best to consider the p..."
entries.dialogueText: “It would be best to consider the political advantages of each one, as well as the practical advantages before making a decision.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""There's merit in the proposal to i..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's merit in the proposal to increase salaries for all health staff, with an extra emphasis on rural areas."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“New contracts for improvements wil..."
entries.dialogueText: “New contracts for improvements will be drawn up immediately.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""In my view, the pressing issue lie..."
entries.dialogueText: "In my view, the pressing issue lies in the quality and accessibility of healthcare in remote areas."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""This approach could incentivize do..."
entries.dialogueText: "This approach could incentivize doctors and nurses to work in these regions where their services are desperately needed."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""This stark disparity between urban..."
entries.dialogueText: "This stark disparity between urban and rural healthcare is a major contributor to the high maternal mortality rates and prevalence of other diseases in our rural communities."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Constructing new hospitals would s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Constructing new hospitals would score us significant political points."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

entries.dialogueText: “I'll prepare the increase as soon as possible. The workers will rejoice.”

entries.dialogueText: “We shall begin plans of hospital constructions immediately.”

entries.dialogueText: "Metropolitan areas are already reaping the benefits of our policies. The rural regions, which trail behind in income, deserve some attention."

entries.dialogueText: "On a larger scale, it would boost satisfaction within the health industry and could contribute significantly to reducing maternal mortality rates, a goal that is close to my heart."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""Addressing this issue is one of my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Addressing this issue is one of my key objectives in this term, and I believe an overhaul of the rural healthcare infrastructure is a critical step in that direction."
